title: Research: Link Predictability in Ad-Hoc Networks for Secure & Robust Communications
content: Authored by Dhruv Upadhyay, Dept. of CSE, NSUT Delhi. Problem: Decentralized wireless systems (MANETs/VANETs) suffer link failures from dynamic mobility and physical shielding. Reactive protocols (AODV/DSR) only trigger route repair post-failure, causing packet surges and latency spikes. Proposed Framework: Proactive topology management combining kinematic forecasting, time-series RSSI exponential smoothing (r_hat_t = alpha*r_t + (1-alpha)*r_hat_{t-1}) and Kalman filtering, explainable machine learning link lifetime models, lightweight AEAD cryptography, and behavioral trust evaluation to secure ad-hoc routes.
